answer_1.quote: We assess our method on diverse datasets across different domains: programming (i.e., MBPP, HumanEval), mathematical reasoning (i.e., GSM8K), and E-commerce customer intent detection (i.e., ECID).
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include Python code, mathematical reasoning solutions, and customer intent classifications in Chinese.

answer_2.quote: We utilize the Pass@k metric to measure the percentage of problems that successfully pass all unit tests within k attempts.

answer_4.quote: Additionally, we implemented human evaluation, randomly sampling and verifying the accuracy of answers.
answer_4.guideline: The human evaluation involved verifying the accuracy of the labeled core intentions in the ECID dataset based on customer interactions, purchase history, and request details.
